title: statusline r5 UX: unscoped writes-nothing collides with init's install mandate
description: Round 5. Lens: ux (validator: DR). Owner: SO session. Defect: 'a non-interactive invocation... writes nothing' is absolute; a cold reader cannot tell whether non-interactive init still installs the environment minus statusline or is a full no-op — ambiguity the revision introduced. Citations verified: contract:162, :187. Proposed: resolved-candidate (scope to the settings write).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Fixed: scoped to 'makes no settings write — the rest of init's installation proceeds unchanged' in both requirement and criterion; the ambiguity is gone. Revision: Install bullet + criterion.
